summary: Frontend-only mobile regression: logged-out auth visibility, create-account switch, and registration into Today passed. Add-task still failed to render the newly submitted task; downstream requested flows were blocked.

integration_issues.issue: After entering a task and tapping add-task, the new task was not visible after 1.8 seconds; the UI showed Review state in the captured failure screenshot and no visible error.

action_items: Trace add-task POST and dashboard refresh in the clean web session; verify the response, active tab state, and task-row rendering after submission.
critical_code_review_comments: The requested add-task regression remains unresolved in the public Expo web flow despite awaiting refresh; no visible error state identifies whether POST or refresh failed.
seed_data_creation: Created unique example.com accounts during UI testing; no seeded credentials changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth visibility, create-account switch, and registration passed. Cleaned local/session storage before the final run. Add-task failure reproduced after registration; later Plan/Focus/Review/navigation checkpoints were not claimed.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: clear web storage, reload public preview, register a unique account, enter a task, tap data-testid=add-task, wait 1.8 seconds. The task row is absent and no .error element is present. Capture POST /api/tasks and GET /api/dashboard responses next; the screenshot unexpectedly shows Review, suggesting tab/state persistence or an event targeting issue in addition to refresh timing.
